scope: Native same-window surface focus restoration and unchanged raw-input isolation proof

native_control.method: With one persistent virtual keyboard, clear raw surface focus and request default-surface focus restoration to the same window; no Hyprflow actions are involved in the control.

fix: Backport stable Hyprland 0.56.2 rawWindowFocus early-return condition: a matching window/null argument is not already focused when the cached surface is null. Require m_focusSurface before returning early.
source_delta: FocusState.cpp only: one condition. No headers, fields, graphics, or ABI layout changes.
input_device: One persistent virtual keyboard spans the proof, matching normal physical-keyboard lifetime; separate keyboard-hotplug behavior is not qualified.
